headline: Vande Bharat Express Timetable Announced for Bengaluru-Goa Route
summary: The schedule for the new Vande Bharat Express connecting Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Goa has been revealed. The service aims to improve travel convenience and intercity rail connectivity.

headline: New Vande Bharat Express Offers Scenic 13-Hour Bengaluru-Goa Trip
summary: Passengers traveling from Bengaluru to Goa can now complete the journey in 13 hours on the new Vande Bharat train. The route offers picturesque views passing through the Western Ghats.

headline: Direct Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Route Replaces Discontinued Service
summary: A new 13-hour Vande Bharat train will connect Bengaluru to Goa via Mangaluru. Meanwhile, the previous Madgaon-Mangaluru service has been discontinued.

headline: Goa Police Inspector Accused of Sexually Assaulting Minor
summary: A police inspector in Goa has been accused of assaulting a minor girl inside the Crime Branch office multiple times. Authorities have initiated legal proceedings following the incident.

headline: FIR Lodged Against Crime Branch Inspector in Minor Assault Case
summary: An FIR has been registered against a Crime Branch police inspector and a woman regarding the alleged sexual assault of a minor. An investigation into the matter is currently underway.

headline: Cop Booked for Assaulting Teenager at Goa Police Station
summary: A police officer in Goa allegedly summoned a teenager to the station under the pretext of a cyber complaint and assaulted her. Official action has been launched against the accused officer.

headline: K Annamalai Completes Ironman 70.3 Challenge in Goa
summary: BJP leader K Annamalai successfully finished the demanding Ironman 70.3 triathlon held in Goa. He publicly shared his experience detailing the physical challenges faced during the event.

headline: FC Goa Defeats Inter Kashi to Claim First ISL Victory
summary: FC Goa secured their first win of the ISL season by edging past Inter Kashi in a closely contested match. The victory marks a breakthrough for the team after earlier setbacks.

headline: Scenic 13-Hour Vande Bharat Route to Link Bengaluru and Goa Soon
summary: Indian Railways is launching a Vande Bharat Express that cuts travel time between Bengaluru and Goa to 13 hours. The scenic route passes through the lush landscape of the Western Ghats.

headline: Goa Dairy Retains Milk Prices Despite Karnataka Price Hike
summary: Goa Dairy has announced it will maintain current milk prices for consumers in the state. The decision comes even as neighboring Karnataka approved a price increase.

headline: Data Reveals Religious Breakdown of Deleted Voters in Goa
summary: Recent reports detail the number of Hindu, Christian, and Muslim voters removed from electoral rolls in Goa. The figures have sparked political discussions regarding voter roll revisions.

headline: AAIB Blames Crew Error for Air India Express Goa Runway Incident
summary: The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau cited pilot miscommunication and error for a runway incursion involving an Air India Express flight in Goa. Safety protocols are under review following the report.

headline: New Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express Route Details Released
summary: Travelers will soon have a new Vande Bharat train service running between Bengaluru and Goa through the Western Ghats. Detailed schedules and stopovers have been published for passengers.

headline: Goa GST Revenue Surges 37 Percent, Outperforming National Average
summary: Goa recorded a 37 percent jump in GST collections, significantly outpacing the national growth rate. Strong economic activity across key commercial sectors contributed to the revenue boost.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Relocates to Goa, Shares Breakdown of Costs
summary: A couple moving from Bengaluru to Goa spent ₹75,500 on relocation expenses and described the shift as entirely worth it. Their post detailing moving costs gained wide attention.

headline: Inspector Facing Charges for Repeated Assault of Minor in Crime Branch
summary: A Goa Crime Branch inspector has been charged after allegedly assaulting a minor victim on office premises. Law enforcement authorities have initiated strict legal proceedings.

headline: Franchu and Chiki Lead FC Goa to First ISL Win Against Inter Kashi
summary: Goals from Franchu and Chiki propelled FC Goa to a victory against Inter Kashi in the ISL. The win earns the team its initial three points of the season.

headline: Army Athlete Biten Singh Wins Ironman 70.3 Goa with Record Time
summary: Indian Army athlete Biten Singh set a new course record to win the Ironman 70.3 triathlon in Goa. His performance established a new benchmark for the event.

headline: Goa Delegation Set to Discuss ST Reservation with Solicitor General
summary: A delegation from Goa is scheduled to meet the Solicitor General to discuss Scheduled Tribe reservation issues. The leaders aim to seek legal clarity and push for speedy resolution.

headline: Goa Dairy Holds Milk Rates Steady as Nandini Hikes Prices
summary: Goa Dairy has chosen not to alter milk prices locally, despite Karnataka's Nandini brand raising rates by ₹8 per liter. Local consumers will see no immediate price increase.

headline: FC Goa Claims 2-1 Victory Over Inter Kashi
summary: FC Goa defeated Inter Kashi 2-1 in their recent ISL fixture thanks to key goals from their forward line. The result gives the team much-needed momentum.

headline: Historical Preservation Issues Delay Old Goa PRASHAD Project
summary: The implementation of the PRASHAD scheme in Old Goa has hit obstacles due to historical heritage regulations. Authorities are working to resolve conservation concerns to proceed with development.

headline: FC Goa Earns First Win of Season Against Inter Kashi
summary: FC Goa opened their winning account in the ISL campaign with a hard-fought victory over Inter Kashi. Team officials praised the players' performance under pressure.

headline: Goa Seeks Win to Break Three-Match Losing Streak
summary: Goa's sports team is looking to turn around its campaign after suffering three consecutive losses. Players are aiming for a strong performance in their upcoming fixture.

headline: Goa Connects Local Artistes and Students with Event Industry
summary: The Goa government launched an initiative linking local folk artistes, self-help groups, and students with the event sector. The goal is to create economic opportunities and showcase regional culture.

headline: Goa Streamlines Marriage Registration Process for Destination Weddings
summary: Goa has introduced faster marriage registration procedures to attract more couples for destination weddings. The move aims to boost the local hospitality and tourism sectors.

headline: Oktoberfest and Ironman Event Cause Severe Traffic Jams in Panaji
summary: Heavy traffic hit Panaji as simultaneous events, including Oktoberfest and the Ironman triathlon, drew crowds to the city. Local police deployed additional personnel to manage congestion.

headline: Goa Air Connectivity Boosted with 84 New Flights Across Airports
summary: Goa's two operational airports have added 84 new flights to expand regional and national air links. The move is expected to support tourism and improve passenger convenience.

headline: Goa Supplies 7.6 Lakh Tonnes of Waste Fuel to Cement Plants
summary: Goa has sent over 7.6 lakh tonnes of processed waste to cement factories to be utilized as alternative fuel. The initiative aids municipal waste management while promoting industrial reuse.

headline: Biten Singh Overcomes Past Challenges to Make History at Ironman Goa
summary: Indian Army athlete Biten Singh bounced back from previous setbacks to win the Ironman 70.3 event in Goa. His victory set a new course record.

headline: Goa-Based Vanaha Gin Launches with Eye on Travel Retail Market
summary: Craft spirit brand Vanaha Gin announced its launch in Goa along with expansion plans for travel retail outlets. The brand aims to capture growing demand in premium markets.

headline: Massive Fire Destroys Over 150 Shops at Vasco Market in Goa
summary: A major fire broke out at the Vasco market in Goa, destroying more than 150 commercial shops. Firefighters worked to contain the blaze, and an investigation into the cause is under way.

headline: Kerala High Court Judge Finishes Ironman 70.3 Triathlon in Goa
summary: Justice Bechu Kurian Thomas of the Kerala High Court successfully completed the Ironman 70.3 triathlon in Goa. The judge completed the swimming, cycling, and running segments within the official time.

headline: Quepem Lantern Maker Preserves Goa's Traditional Diwali Art
summary: An artisan in Quepem continues the traditional craft of handmaking festive lanterns for Diwali in Goa. Local residents celebrate his dedication to keeping cultural heritage alive.

headline: Police Bust Multi-Crore Scam Operated from Luxury Goa Villa
summary: Authorities uncovered a multi-crore fraud scheme operated by twelve young men renting a luxury villa in Goa. Police seized equipment and arrested key suspects involved in the racket.

headline: Dempo Scores Late Goal to Beat Bengaluru United
summary: Dempo SC secured a victory against Bengaluru United courtesy of a late goal in their recent match. The dramatic win earned the team vital points.

headline: Annamalai Finishes Second Ironman 70.3 Despite Muscle Cramps
summary: K Annamalai completed his second Ironman 70.3 challenge in Goa after overcoming severe muscle cramps during the race. He shared his experience of fighting through physical pain to cross the finish line.

headline: Chiki Scores Winner as FC Goa Beats Inter Kashi 2-1
summary: FC Goa earned a 2-1 victory over Inter Kashi, with striker Chiki delivering the decisive winning goal. The win represents a vital turnaround for the squad.

headline: Vibrant Goa 2026 Panel Urges Urgent Data Protection Readiness
summary: Industry experts at Vibrant Goa 2026 called for immediate action on data protection and AI security frameworks. Panels emphasized the need for safe digital infrastructure for future tech growth.

headline: Cipla Reports Q2 Profit Fall as FDA Inspects Verna Goa Plant
summary: Cipla Ltd recorded a dip in Q2 revenue and profit amid an ongoing US FDA inspection at its Verna facility in Goa. The facility received a Voluntary Action Indicated status.

headline: Goa Congress Leaders Attend INDIA Bloc Protest Rally in Delhi
summary: Congress leaders from Goa joined a major national protest in New Delhi organized by the INDIA bloc against current land policies. The delegation voiced local concerns at the central demonstration.

headline: Award-Winning Goa Police Inspector Booked in POCSO Case
summary: A decorated Goa police inspector who previously received the President's Colour has been booked under the POCSO Act. Authorities registered the case following severe allegations of minor abuse.

headline: Arvind Kejriwal Expresses Confidence in AAP's Goa Future
summary: AAP leader Arvind Kejriwal stated that voters in Goa are seeking an alternative to the BJP and Congress. He expressed optimism about AAP's chances of forming a government in the state.

headline: FC Goa Edges Out Inter Kashi FC with Key Goals
summary: FC Goa earned three points after defeating Inter Kashi FC in a hard-fought match. Tactical adjustments and key strikes helped the team secure the win.

headline: Goa Revises Land Rates for 2026-27, Tops ₹25,000 per Sqm in Prime Areas
summary: The Goa government announced new land valuation rates for 2026-27, raising prices in Panaji and coastal Bardez up to ₹25,000 per square meter. The revision updates land transaction benchmarks.

headline: SGPDA Criticized as Market Revival Promises Remain Unfulfilled
summary: Local vendors expressed disappointment over unfulfilled assurances by the SGPDA regarding market infrastructure upgrades. Traders are demanding prompt intervention to restore commercial facilities.

headline: Goa Announces Traffic Diversions for November 1 Ironman Event
summary: Authorities issued traffic advisories announcing major diversions across Goa on November 1 for the Ironman triathlon. Commuters are advised to plan travel around the event route.

headline: New Vande Bharat Trains to Connect Bengaluru with Goa and Mumbai
summary: Indian Railways is expanding Vande Bharat services connecting Bengaluru to both Goa and Mumbai. The new trains aim to cut travel times and boost inter-state connectivity.

headline: Bengaluru Couple Outlines ₹75,500 Expense for Moving to Goa
summary: A couple who relocated from Bengaluru to Goa shared their total moving expense of ₹75,500, citing enhanced lifestyle as worth the cost. The breakdown details shipping, travel, and setup expenses.

headline: Biten Singh Breaks Record at Ironman 70.3 Goa Triathlon
summary: Army athlete Biten Singh delivered a landmark performance to set a course record at Ironman 70.3 Goa. He finished ahead of the field to claim the title.
